assertions.name: EmFermionLoop_equals_qbracket2_symbolically
assertions.source: sympy.simplify(EmFermionLoop_V_F(q) - [2]_q) = 0 — the categorical primitive evaluates to the q-dim of the fundamental rep exactly.

description: Phase 2 of the RT 2-loop derivation plan (#1495): defines EmFermionLoop categorical primitive (closed strand in fundamental SU_q(2) rep, Markov-closed = unknot with q-dim [2]_q per PR #1521 identification) and explains structurally why the H_3 Hecke-word candidates from PR #1466 were all refuted (wrong H_n level: matter strand is in H_1 with NO crossings, not in H_3). Symbolic verification via sympy shows EmFermionLoop_{V_F}(q) = [2]_q exactly.

data.phase_2_primitive_definition: EmFermionLoop_V(q) = Markov_close(identity_in_H_1, rep=V) = dim_q(V) = [V_dim]_q. For V = V_F (fundamental, dim=2), EmFermionLoop_V_F(q) = [2]_q.
data.h3_refutation_explanation: The H_3 candidates from PR #1466 (σ_2², σ_2·σ_1·σ_2^-1, [σ_1, σ_2], σ_2·σ_1^9·σ_2, Δ_3²) were all refuted because they put the matter strand IN H_3 with explicit braid crossings — wrong topology. The correct categorical fermion loop is in H_1 (closed strand with no crossings) with 2 vertex insertions that are categorical couplings, not braid crossings.
data.phase_2_status: ESTABLISHED — primitive defined, H_3 refutation resolved
